prompt: Green trades lunch for a dinosaur book
title: Lunch for Dinosaur Book
irony: Green trades his lunch to read about hungry dinosaurs and grows hungrier than any dinosaur until sharing the book brings lunch back.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Lunch trays steam on Gold's counter while Black waves a big dinosaur book.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green names every dinosaur, corrects Gold with Actually, and begs to hold the book.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black offers the book for Green's lunch tray and Green's tummy rumbles loudly.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids chant about lunch for the dinosaur book around the steaming trays.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Green swaps his tray, reads fast, takes roar literally and scares his own tummy.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Green roars like a hungry T-rex, trips over feet, and Black munches the traded sandwich.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The chant returns around the counter as Green's tummy growls louder than roars.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold watches the hungry reader with Navy and remembers quietly shared rainy-day soup.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold decides to split a warm lunch and Green offers dino facts back bite by bite.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The hook turns as Gold sings sharing lunch and the book passes hand to hand.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Lunch trays steam again as Green reads aloud and everyone munches and roars together.
